name: Tokyo Prince Hotel
accessSummary: Toei Mita Line Onarimon Station (Exit A1): 1 min walk / Toei Asakusa Line and Oedo Line Daimon Station (Exit A6): 7 min walk / JR and Tokyo Monorail Hamamatsucho Station: 10 min walk / Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line Kamiyacho Station (Exit 3): 10 min walk. A free shuttle bus runs between Hamamatsucho Station (Daimon Station) and the hotel.
notice: The party plans cover the medium banquet rooms on the 3F and 11F; if the 2F large banquet hall is used, a venue fee and a sound and lighting fee are charged separately. Reservations for the Meeting Package are accepted from 3 months before the usage date. Food allergy support covers only 8 items (shrimp, crab, walnut, wheat, buckwheat, egg, milk, peanut). For the Meeting Package, tell the hotel at least 2 weeks before the usage date.

rooms.name: Ho-o-no-Ma (entire)
rooms.note: 2F. Up to 900 for dinner and 2,000 for buffet. It can be split into 2 rooms, west and east.

rooms.name: Takasago & Suehiro
rooms.note: 11F. The top floor of the hotel.

rooms.name: Izumi, Katsura, Kaede, Nishiki and Fuyo (with sofa set)
rooms.note: 4F. Meeting style for 10 people. Can be used for small meetings or as waiting rooms.

rooms.name: Marguerite
rooms.note: 11F. Split into 2 rooms, and also suitable as waiting rooms.

ops.parking: Hourly parking is 500 yen per 30 minutes from 8:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M. and 100 yen per 60 minutes from 8:00 P.M. to 8:00 A.M. The maximum charge is 6,000 yen for use until 12:00 midnight on the same day. There is no maximum charge during Golden Week, the year-end and New Year holidays, and specific days set for large banquets and the like. Service parking is free for up to 4 hours for banquets, and 1,000 yen per night for overnight guests. Advance reservations are not possible for regular vehicles. Large buses are reserved through the Smart Park bus reservation service from 3 months before the usage date until 5:00 P.M. on the day before (1,100 yen per 30 minutes, maximum charge of 8,250 yen from 8:00 P.M. to 8:00 A.M.). (Source: Parking Fee Guide revised November 1, 2023, Access, FAQ)
ops.waitingRooms: "Izumi, Katsura, Kaede, Nishiki and Fuyo" on the 4F (59㎡, meeting style for 10 people) can be used for small meetings or as waiting rooms. "Marguerite" on the 11F (82㎡) is split into 2 rooms and is also suitable as waiting rooms.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has a buffet dining restaurant, Japanese cuisine (Japanese food, sushi, tempura), Chinese cuisine, yakiniku, a cafe and bar, a tea salon, a main bar and a bakery. Some restaurants have private rooms.
